sections.title: Did the drama get it wrong?

items.q: Why do students think *重器* botched the death file?
items.a: They opened the **1979** 刑诉法. Art. 15: intermediate court for death / life. Art. 131: **ten-day** appeal. The show has a **county** court and **three** days.

items.q: Why can the drama still be right?
items.a: The set is **1983 严打**, not 1979. [[strike-hard-procedure-override]]: 16 Aug notice sends some death files to grassroots courts. 2 Sept decision cuts appeal to **three days** when 民愤极大.

items.q: What is the odd appeal rule?
items.a: Lighter sentence: **ten days**. Death: **three**. Pullback 2 Dec 1983. A 1987 SPC note still found **30+** county courts in one province on death / life files.

items.q: What do 滕兴善 and 佘祥林 prove?
items.a: [[wrongful-conviction-needs-miracle]]. 滕 executed; 石小荣 was trafficked, not dead. 佘: **3,995** days; wife walked back. 20-case study: **85%** real killer, **15%** living 'victim'.

items.q: Where did death review actually sit?
items.a: [[death-review-twenty-year-loan]]. 1979 law: SPC. A month into 1980 it was lent to 高院. The 'temporary' exception lasted **20+ years**. 1 Jan **2007** the SPC took it back.
**董伟** 2002 枪下留人. Stay. Rehear. Still execute. 1996/97 statutes restated SPC review; a 26 Sept 1997 notice kept the old loan.
[[means-are-the-seed]]. 手段是种子, 目的是树. 2010 exclusion rules, 2012 刑诉法. A just slogan does not clean a tortured confession.

items.q: Why 法治天下 tastes like shame here?
items.a: Every statute step has a body behind it. Forget the road in, you do not know where it goes. Remember so it is not reused.
